Spill.et: From Middle Low German spille, from a contraction of Proto-West Germanic *spinnilu (“spindle”). Doublet of Spindel.

spillerig.et: From Spille (“spindle”) + -ig. The former is a High as well as Low German variant of Spindel; from Middle High German spille and Middle Low German spille, from which latter also Spill (“capstan”). Eventually from Proto-West Germanic *spinnilu.
